summary: Iter98b 25-item QA sweep (focused on the 11 items E1 had not independently verified). Approach: source-code audit + backend regression. Live web UI smoke could not render past the Expo default Welcome page (preview environment / Expo Router web-bundler quirk independent of this change-set), so frontend verification was done via code inspection against the explicit acceptance criteria for each item. Backend regression suite (96/97/97c/97d/98/99 + admin_panel_v2) = 100 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed.

item_2_chat_timestamps.evidence: /app/frontend/app/messages/chat.tsx L102-141: formatTime appends 'Z' when ISO lacks tz (regex /[Z]|[+-]\d\d:?\d\d$/), then toLocaleTimeString renders local. messagesWithSeparators useMemo emits {__sep:true} rows with formatDayHeader giving 'Today' / 'Yesterday' / weekday / 'Mon, Jun 4'. Separator View has data-testid='day-separator'.

item_16_stripe_upsell_removed.evidence: /app/frontend/app/trainer/(tabs)/earnings.tsx L183-194: the 'Set Up Stripe Payouts' branded button is gone. Only the green confirmation pill 'Stripe payouts enabled' + 'Manage' link renders, and only when connectStatus.onboarded === true. grep for 'connect-bank-btn' across earnings.tsx returns 0 matches.

item_12_back_history.evidence: Profile (app/trainee/(tabs)/profile.tsx L738/749/761) pushes to NON-tab routes: /trainee/achievements, /trainee/leaderboard, /trainee/saved-trainers. saved-trainers.tsx (L1-11) is a stack-resident wrapper around the tab content explicitly designed so router.back() returns to Profile (header comment documents this fix).

item_13_back_button_visibility.evidence: chat.tsx L228-230 backButton 44x44 rgba(255,255,255,0.2) circle, Ionicons arrow-back white. trainer-detail.tsx L425/444, achievements.tsx L450, leaderboard.tsx L132 all use 24px white arrow-back on navy. Tap targets are 40x40 or larger.

item_15_logo_glow.evidence: login.premium.tsx imports PremiumLogo + comment 'iter97 (#15): stronger orange halo around the wordmark' (L220), signup.premium.tsx passes haloIntensity={0.85}. PremiumLogo.tsx implements an animated ember halo (shadowColor #FF7A00, shadowRadius size*0.35, pulsing opacity 0.35->0.75) plus drop shadow on the logo itself (shadowOpacity 0.55, shadowRadius 28).

item_18_nearby_avatars.evidence: Trainer side (/app/frontend/app/trainer/(tabs)/home.tsx L1040-1051): when trainee.profilePhoto is falsy, still renders a generic Ionicons name='person' inside a LinearGradient placeholder — NOT initials. UserAvatar is NOT used in this 'Nearby Trainees' grid. The trainee-side Nearby Trainers carousel implementation uses a separate map component; verify there as well.

item_19_profile_tab_avatar.evidence: trainee/(tabs)/_layout.tsx L141-142 and trainer/(tabs)/_layout.tsx L106-107 both render <UserAvatar user={user} size=... ring={focused} /> for the Profile tab icon (comment cites iter97 #19).

item_22_hide_customer_pricing_from_train.evidence: /app/frontend/app/trainer/set-rates.tsx L173-174: preview shows ONLY 'You: <take-home>'. The customer-total/customer-pays line is documented as hidden ('iter96b (#22): trainer only sees their take-home; customer total is hidden'). Disclaimer L218 reads 'Your take-home shown above.' No 'Customer Total' or 'Customer Pays' string remains.

item_24_pricing_sync.evidence: trainer-detail.tsx L170-218 (calculatePrice): reads tierRates per-duration (inPerson30/45/60/90Cents, virtual30/45/60/90Cents) as source-of-truth, falls back to legacy hourly only when missing. priceCents is then passed downstream (L929-931, L970) into schedule-training and confirm-booking via router params. confirm-booking.tsx L79 reads params.priceCents and uses it verbatim — no override unless missing.

item_25_book_session_dynamic_pricing.evidence: Single-session book flow (trainer-detail.tsx + confirm-booking.tsx) IS dynamic per duration 30/45/60/90 for both in_person and virtual via tierRates. HOWEVER recurring-sessions.tsx L51-55 uses ONLY params.rateCents (a single hourly-equivalent value) × duration/60 to compute price — it does NOT consult outdoor30/45/60/90Cents, virtual30/45/60/90Cents. Recurring is therefore not per-duration tier-aware. Also note hardcoded $2.00 service fee on L57 (should be $2.99 per iter96b #23).

backend_regression_88plus.evidence: 100 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed (test_iteration96_corporate, test_iteration97_sprint_cd, test_iteration97c_polish, test_iteration97d_polish, test_iteration98_admin_dashboard, test_iteration99_csv_export_extras, test_admin_panel_v2). XML: /app/test_reports/pytest/iter100_regression.xml.

ui_bugs.component: Trainer Home — Nearby Trainees thumbnail grid
ui_bugs.issue: Fallback when profilePhoto is missing renders a generic Ionicons person icon, not initials via UserAvatar. Violates Item #18 acceptance criteria.

integration_issues.issue: recurring-sessions.tsx ignores per-duration tierRates and computes price = rateCents * duration/60 from a single param. 30/45/90 min recurring sessions therefore won't reflect the trainer's per-duration prices.
Hardcoded serviceFee = 2.00 (should be 2.99 to align with iter96b/#23 flat service fee).

confirm-booking.tsx getMinPrice() still hard-codes $30/$40/$60 defaults when priceCents param is 0. Acceptable as a guard, but worth noting it bypasses tierRates if upstream forgets to send priceCents.

action_items: Item #18: replace generic person icon fallback in app/trainer/(tabs)/home.tsx (L1043-1049) with <UserAvatar user={trainee} size={...}/> so initials are shown when profilePhoto missing. Verify trainee-side Nearby Trainers carousel does the same.

Item #25: update app/trainee/recurring-sessions.tsx to receive trainer.tierRates (inPerson{30,45,60,90}Cents / virtual{30,45,60,90}Cents) and select sessionPriceCents by selected duration, mirroring trainer-detail.tsx logic.
Item #25 (#23): change serviceFee in recurring-sessions.tsx from 2.00 to 2.99 to match flat fee policy.
Optional: align confirm-booking.tsx hardcoded fallback defaults with tierRates or remove the fallback once tierRates seed is guaranteed.
critical_code_review_comments: earnings.tsx L186-194: connectedBanner still uses the COLORS.success light tint over the orange/navy background — readable but tester should spot-check contrast on device.

PremiumLogo.tsx halo relies on RN shadow (iOS) + elevation (Android); on web shadow* props are not rendered the same way — the orange glow may be subtle on web builds even though native is correct (Item #15 native PASS, web visual fidelity not guaranteed by this preview env).
recurring-sessions.tsx mixes legacy single-rate model with the new per-duration tier model — needs refactor to fully fix Item #25.

Frontend live-rendering check could not be performed: https://highlight-vibe-bugs.preview.emergentagent.com/ serves the Expo default 'Welcome to Expo' page rather than the app shell. This appears to be a preview/web-bundler issue, not a code change in this iter — but it blocks any Playwright UI assertion. Recommend main agent verify on a native device/simulator or fix expo web entry.

success_rate.frontend: 9/11 items PASS, 1 PARTIAL (#18), 1 MIXED (#25 recurring path)

rca of the issue: Item #18 partial fail RCA: the trainer-home 'Nearby Trainees' grid was updated to display profile photos, but the no-photo branch still emits Ionicons name='person' instead of the unified UserAvatar fallback that renders initials. Fix: swap the conditional with a single <UserAvatar user={{avatarUrl: trainee.profilePhoto, fullName: trainee.fullName}} size={56} /> call. Item #25 MIXED RCA: the single-session booking flow was migrated to tierRates per duration but recurring-sessions.tsx was not — it predates the per-duration model and still works off a single rateCents param. Fix: pass the full tierRates object as a param (or fetch from the trainer endpoint inside the screen) and select by selectedDuration before multiplying by sessionsPerWeek.
